gloss: wound, cut, opening of a wound

definitions.gloss: wound, cut, opening of a wound
definitions.explanation: The opening or site of a wound on the body where tissue has been damaged.

examples.japanese: {傷口|きずぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧。
{傷口|きずぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消毒|しょうどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{傷口|きずぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{治|なお}る。

notes:
{傷口|きずぐち} combines {傷|きず} (wound) + {口|ぐち} (opening), specifically referring to the opening or surface of a wound.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {傷口|きずぐち}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ: to close a wound
- {傷口|きずぐち}を{消毒|しょうどく}する: to disinfect a wound
- {傷口|きずぐち}が{治|なお}る: the wound heals
- {傷口|きずぐち}が{開|ひら}く: the wound opens/reopens
- {傷口|きずぐち}に{触|さわ}る: to touch a wound

USAGE:
{傷口|きずぐち}に{塩|しお}を{塗|ぬ}る means "to rub salt in a wound" — to make a painful situation worse.

RELATED WORDS:
- {傷|きず}: wound, injury (broader term)
- {切|き}り{傷|きず}: a cut
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}: a scrape, abrasion
- {火傷|やけど}: a burn
